items.author: strategist
items.text: The Highland Valley Copper strike ends with a ratified new labour agreement

evidence.note: A CBC headline reports Highland Valley Copper was ordered to stop using replacement workers, which pressures the company toward a deal, but no tentative or ratified agreement appears in today's news, and the headline gives no figures.

items.author: geologist
items.text: The Highland Valley Copper strike ends, with a tentative or ratified labour agreement announced by the company or the union

evidence.note: The same CBC headline (Highland Valley Copper ordered to stop using replacement workers) bears on a tentative or ratified agreement without showing one yet, and it gives no figures.

items.text: Panama and First Quantum publicly announce an agreed timetable for the Cobre Panama restart

evidence.note: The Northern Miner's "Panama authorizes First Quantum restart talks" shows talks are authorized, but it is not an agreed timetable, and the headline gives no figures.

items.author: geologist
items.text: Panama and First Quantum publicly announce an agreed timetable for restarting Cobre Panama operations

evidence.note: The Northern Miner's "Panama authorizes First Quantum restart talks" shows the talks are authorized, but it does not yet show a publicly announced timetable, and the headline gives no figures.
